Name: Free The Toolbar
Author: danmw3
Description:
[color=gold][b][size=5]Free The Toolbar - Version: 1.0.0[/size][/b][/color][b]
[color=orange][size=3]Requires SMAPI[/size][/color][/b]

When changing slots in the toolbar, Stardew will normally jump over empty slots preventing you from just having an empty hand.
This mod unlocks the empty slots so you can select them just like you would any other slot with an item in it.
